input.quote: The exclusive remedy of either party in a claim against the other under this Agreement shall be the recovery of its direct damages. In no event shall either party be liable to the other for the recovery of any special, indirect or consequential damages
input.rationale: Section 15 is mutual and excludes indirect/consequential damages, and it carves out Sections 13 (IP indemnity) and 14 (confidentiality), but it contains no monetary cap at all — direct-damages exposure is unlimited for both parties, so it fails the fallback requirement of a mutual cap of 12 months' fees. We added the mutual greater-of cap (12 months' fees / USD 1,000,000), expanded the carve-outs to gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, and confirmed our fee obligations are not "damages".

input.quote: Garman agrees to indemnify Sparkling and hold it harmless from any and all losses, damages and expenses including without limitation, court costs, arbitration fees, penalties, fines, amounts paid in settlement of claims and reasonable legal fees and expenses of investigation (collectively the "Losses") which Sparkling or any of its respective officers or directors may incur due to a breach of this warranty.
input.rationale: Garman gives a non-infringement/title warranty backed by an indemnity for our Losses, with the usual procure/modify/replace remedies, and Section 15 expressly places Section 13 outside the liability limitation, so the indemnity is not capped or gutted. No reciprocal indemnity is imposed on us. This sits at the fallback: we note (not flag) the absence of express defence/settlement-control mechanics, the lack of a refund remedy, and the tight 10-day claim-notice requirement, which we would prefer to relax to "prompt written notice".

input.quote: (g) not use the Work to act as a service bureau in whole or in part, for any other Person, except for any affiliate of Sparkling operating at the Authorized Locations.
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restraint binds Sparkling's business. Section 3 contains only ordinary software use restrictions (no service-bureau use of Garman's own Software), which do not restrict what businesses we operate or what products we may buy or build.

input.quote: a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use
input.rationale: No exclusivity, sole-source or "all requirements" obligation binds Sparkling; the only use of "exclusive" is the non-exclusive licence grant and the non-exclusive jurisdiction clause. We remain free to buy from other suppliers (Schedule A was not provided, so we will confirm no sole-source language sits in the Fee Schedule).
